title: Carnell Tate, who was willing to "give up the bank" for 17, settled on 14 with Titans

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Carnell Tate, who was willing to "give up the bank" for 17, settled on 14 with Titans
sources.description: Titans receiver Carnell Tate, one of my personal favorite 2026 prospects because of his Lego habit, said in the hours before he was drafted that he would "give up the bank" to get his preferred number, 17, at the next level.
